problem_statement: Build a brand-new /timeline page from scratch on this Gatsby portfolio site (priyesh18__gatsby-portfolio). The route /timeline does not exist yet (baseline is empty/404). Create src/pages/timeline.jsx that reuses the site's shared Layout (the intro sidebar with the 'Hello, I'm Priyesh Patel.' heading, the Projects/Blogs nav, the Github/Twitter social links, and the dark/light theme toggle) exactly like the home page, so the new page is consistent with its sibling pages. The page shows a data-driven, year-by-year list of career milestones rendered as an accordion: each milestone row shows a year and a title, and clicking a row expands it to reveal a detail paragraph (and collapses the previously open one). The page must reuse the site's existing colors/spacing/typography (the CSS custom properties in global.scss) and be responsive with no horizontal overflow at 390px.
required_content: An intro paragraph containing 'the milestones that shaped my journey'
A vertical accordion list of career milestones, each row a clickable header showing a year (e.g. 2016) and a milestone title (h3)
Milestone titles include 'Started BSc in Computer Science', 'First internship as a web developer', and 'Published open-source portfolio starter'
Each accordion header carries aria-expanded and a data-milestone attribute; only one panel is open at a time
Clicking a milestone header expands its detail panel to reveal a paragraph (e.g. the 2018 internship milestone reveals 'Spent a summer shipping features on a production React codebase...')
The shared site chrome reused from the Layout: the 'Hello, I'm Priyesh Patel.' intro heading, the Projects/Blogs nav, and the Github and Twitter social links
The section heading text is the word Timeline (rendered uppercase as TIMELINE via the shared section-title style)

The five milestone years shown as accordion headers include 2016 (Started BSc in Computer Science) and 2018 (First internship as a web developer); the third named milestone is Published open-source portfolio starter
design_constraints: Reuse the shared <Layout> component (intro sidebar + nav + social links + theme toggle) so the page matches sibling pages like the home page
Reuse the site's CSS custom-property color tokens (var(--bg), var(--bg-secondary), var(--text-main), var(--text-secondary)) from global.scss

The accordion must be a real client-side interaction: clicking a header toggles its panel via component state, aria-expanded reflects the open state, and the detail text is only present in the DOM when the row is open
Namespace new page CSS classes with a unique prefix (tl-) to avoid colliding with the global stylesheet
Responsive: single column on mobile (390px) with zero horizontal overflow; the header may wrap but must not overflow

Color palette (from the shared global.scss tokens the page reuses): primary text and borders are near-black rgb(21,21,21) (#151515), secondary text is grey rgb(93,93,93) (#5d5d5d), page background is light grey rgb(235,235,235) (#ebebeb) with white rgb(255,255,255) (#ffffff) surfaces; do not introduce new accent colors

Typography: system sans-serif font stack (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, ...); the section heading is small (13px) bold uppercase, milestone header text is 16px, and the shared intro title is a large 64px bold h1

Layout: single-column accordion in the main content column to the right of the intro sidebar; each milestone header is a full-width clickable button (~24px padding) with square corners (0px border-radius) showing the year and title; the shared theme-toggle control is a small round (pill) button
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /timeline (near-empty stub, no layout); reference 完整实现 (Layout 复用 + 5 milestone accordion + expand/collapse interaction + mobile responsive); bad 破坏 interaction (openId hardcoded null + header onClick no-op) → 默认渲染与 reference 一致(过 dom/consistency/visual/overflow),仅 interaction_assertions FAIL (点击 header 后 detail panel 从不出现). 三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同. Infra fixes applied identically to all 3: node-sass 4.14.1 -> sass 1.49.11 (dart-sass, Node 22, #18x); gatsby-node.js GitHub API fetch -> static inline repo data (offline, #18w); gatsby-plugin-offline already commented out in template (#18ai N/A); no NODE_ENV-guarded fetch in src (#18ao N/A). Cross-page consistency (#18ag) encoded as dom_assertions binding shared nav+social links on BOTH desktop_timeline AND desktop_home. Re-targeted from /testimonials (dedup collision with slot_566) to /timeline + accordion interaction.
